title: Correct force magnitude
description: Essential: The final numerical answer must be exactly 2.88 × 10⁻²⁸ N (or equivalent).

title: Coulomb's law application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Coulomb's law formula F = k|q₁q₂|/r².

title: Absolute value for magnitude
description: Important: The calculation must use the absolute values of the charges or correctly handle the negative sign to yield a positive force magnitude.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The working should show correct unit handling, leading to the final unit of Newtons (N).

title: Sign error in product
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses a negative force magnitude or forgets to take the absolute value/product magnitude.
